title: feat: plane buffer pool and a measured p010 copy

commit.merge_subject: merge: feat: plane buffer pool and a measured p010 copy

description: PlaneBufferPool (pure, JVM-tested): a small pool of byte arrays so the decoded-plane copy allocates nothing in steady state. Measured on the device with the production path (MediaCodec ByteBuffer output, P010 requested, planes via getOutputImage) on the Mi-Log 4K clip: copying Y + CbCr (24.9 MB) per frame takes a median 1.7 ms with the pool (2 allocations over 60 frames) against 10.5 ms with fresh arrays; the CPU preview's 800-910 ms copy spikes were this allocation pressure. Not yet wired into the CPU adapter (decoded frames may be held across frames there; the E0b-3 upload path owns its staging). The probe test gained selectable variants and the P010 copy timing.
